title: Awaz Health Insurance Scheme (Kerala)
content: The Awaz Health Insurance Scheme is a specialized welfare project launched by the Government of Kerala for migrant workers (Inter-State Migrants). Key Benefits: 1. Medical Treatment Cover: Up to ₹15,000 annually for free inpatient care at empanelled government and government-approved hospitals across Kerala. 2. Accidental Death & Disability Cover: ₹2,00,000 in case of accidental death or permanent physical disability. 3. Free Registration: Migrant workers between 18 and 60 years of age can enroll free of charge using Aadhaar Card, Voters ID, or Passport. 4. Smart Awaz Card: Enrolled workers receive a biometric Awaz Smart Card issued by the Kerala Labour Department.
sources: Kerala State Labour & Skills Department (Awaz Portal)

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY & Karunya Health Scheme
content: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) & PM-JAY provide cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover: 1. Coverage Limit: Up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary & tertiary hospital care. 2. Portability: AB PM-JAY is fully portable across India. Migrant workers registered in any Indian state can access cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital in Kerala. 3. Empanelled Hospitals in Kerala: Includes General Hospital Ernakulam, Government Medical College Kalamassery, District Hospital Kozhikode, and Trivandrum Medical College.
sources: National Health Authority (NHA) & State Health Agency (SHA) Kerala

title: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA ID)
content: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) is a unique 14-digit digital health ID created under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). Benefits & Setup: 1. Unique Health Number: Combines all your medical prescriptions, lab reports, and vaccination history into one digital file accessible anywhere in India. 2. Creation Steps: Open the Aaroham portal or ABHA app, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number or Mobile number, verify via SMS OTP, and set your ABHA address (e.g. name@abdm). 3. Privacy & Consent: Doctors and hospitals can view your health records ONLY after you grant explicit OTP-based consent on your phone.
sources: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare

title: Government Hospitals & Clinics in Ernakulam District
content: Key Public Hospitals & Clinics for Migrant Workers in Ernakulam/Perumbavoor: 1. Perumbavoor Government Taluk Hospital (Phone: 0484-2592233) — 24x7 Emergency, General Medicine, OPD for migrant workers, Free Diagnostics. 2. Ernakulam General Hospital (Phone: 0484-2361251) — Multi-speciality tertiary care, free surgery, ICU, dialysis unit. 3. Govt Medical College Kalamassery (Phone: 0484-2755000) — Cardiology, Orthopedics, Pulmonology, 24x7 Casualty. 4. Primary Health Center (PHC) Rayamangalam (Phone: 0484-2523410) — Routine immunization, TB screening, free medicines.
sources: District Medical Office (DMO) Health Services, Ernakulam

title: Government Hospitals in Kozhikode, Thrissur & Trivandrum
content: Major Government Hospitals in Northern & Southern Kerala: 1. Kozhikode Government Medical College (Phone: 0495-2350216) — Largest tertiary referral center in Malabar, free specialized care. 2. Thrissur Government District Hospital (Phone: 0487-2421255) — Emergency trauma care, pediatric, pulmonology. 3. Trivandrum Medical College Hospital (Phone: 0471-2528300) — State capital referral super-speciality hospital.

title: Tuberculosis (TB) Free Screening & Nikshay Poshan Scheme
content: Tuberculosis Control & Support Program in Kerala: 1. Free Screening & Diagnosis: Any worker experiencing continuous cough for >2 weeks, fever, or weight loss can get a free Sputum Test and GeneXpert test at any Govt PHC or Taluk Hospital. 2. Free Treatment (DOTS): Complete 6-month TB drug regimen provided free of charge under National Tuberculosis Elimination Program (NTEP). 3. Nikshay Poshan Yojana: Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) of ₹500/month provided to TB patients during treatment for nutritional support.

title: Malaria, Dengue & Communicable Disease Screening
content: Vector-Borne & Infectious Disease Prevention Guidelines for Migrant Workers: 1. Mobile Screening Camps: Kerala Health Department conducts weekly free blood smear tests for Malaria and NS1 Antigen test for Dengue at migrant labor camps in Perumbavoor, Aluva, and Payyannur. 2. Prevention: Use mosquito nets, avoid stagnant water accumulation around labor accommodation ('Apna Ghar'), and seek immediate medical help for high fever with chills. 3. Hepatitis B & C Screening: Free vaccination and antiviral therapy available at District Hospitals.
sources: State Vector Borne Disease Control Program (SVBDCP) Kerala

title: Emergency Numbers & Health Helplines in Kerala
content: Essential Emergency & Tele-Health Contact Numbers: 1. Free Ambulance Service: Call 108 (KIVS 24x7 Emergency Response). 2. DISHA Kerala Health Helpline: Call 1056 or 0471-2552056 (24x7 Multilingual health advice in Hindi, Bengali, Oriya, Tamil, Malayalam, English). 3. Kerala Migrant Labour Welfare Helpline: Call 155214. 4. Women Helpline: Call 1091.
sources: Kerala State Emergency Operations Centre (SEOC) & DISHA

title: Migrant Worker Rights & Occupational Health Standards
content: Occupational Health & Hygiene Standards for Inter-State Workers in Kerala: 1. Medical Inspection: Employers & construction contractors are mandatory bound by the Kerala Interstate Migrant Workers Act to provide annual health checkups and sanitary living conditions. 2. Health Identification: Every migrant worker in Kerala is entitled to hold an ABHA Health Card & Awaz Welfare Card. 3. Grievances: Worksite safety hazards or unpaid medical claims can be reported to the District Labour Officer (DLO).
sources: Kerala Interstate Migrant Workers Welfare Board
